openFindings.title: The release runner reports a clean pass while five checked-in parity and residency scripts never run
Gate wiring derives the existence-check path from the second whitespace token
figma-developer-mcp@latest and unversioned mcp-remote float while the rest of the system pins by version and base_commit
Redaction rule is scoped to an undefined term and weaker than its own catalog leaf
vendor-sync.py validates its discovered upstream root but not its override root
92 packet-local changelog entries in the placement sk-create-changelog deprecated; no global product-owner component
.gitignore omits Python cache directories that already exist inside the shippable skill folder
Kernel's retrieval table undercounts the example documents the package ships
The upload guide's final step names a smoke matrix that no playbook document carries
Format validator has no JSDoc across 34 functions and no bracketed console prefix
Nine live shell runners omit -e; four document why, five parity wrappers record nothing
exclude list mixes build output with upstream content, no rationale
two sync mechanisms, disjoint verbs, zero cross-reference
Hub layout block calls the two browser trees packets and no packets in one line
About 11,800 words load before task work and AGENTS.md duplicates registry precedence in prose
Two incompatible vendoring models coexist and vendored packets have no local-edit path
Kernel review record cannot answer whether the Project kernel is current
Parity note is 22,351 words in 136 lines with two headings, leaving the hand-parity method without an index
